description: Maps PyPI 'License :: OSI Approved :: X' trove classifiers to SPDX ids so PyPI licenses classify via the existing allowed/conditional/forbidden license-tier files without modification.
unmappedBehavior: A classifier absent from this map is passed through as its raw trove string; forbidden-licenses.json's pattern list (proprietary/unclear/unknown) and the shared license classifier's default-deny both already handle an unrecognized token as Forbidden — never silently Accepted.
